edits.text: One proposed account treats 四 as an earlier graph for 呬, depicting breath, later reused to write “four” because the words may have sounded alike. In one Old Chinese reconstruction system, the reported forms are 呬 *hrids and 四 *hljids; this comparison does not establish what the depicted referent was called or prove that borrowing occurred. A separate proposal treats 四 as an earlier graph for 泗, depicting nasal discharge, later reused for “four.” That proposal lacks textual attestation.
